Maya (CS): Hi team, quick weekly check-in for SummitAI. Key flags: onboarding at 70% complete, renewal conversation next quarter, small p99 regressions on /completion non-stream. Dropping the short table and notes.

Ravi (Solutions): thanks — looking for breakdown by route+model and streaming vs non-streaming so we can recommend defaults for staging.

Maya (CS): rolling 7d windows below. p95/p99 in ms, error rate, avg tokens.

```
route        model     mode         p95  p99   err%  avg_tokens
/chat        t6-large  streaming    220  760   0.25  420
/chat        t6-large  non-stream   410 1300   1.0   420
/completion  gpt-lite  sync         560 1700   1.8   1500
/embed       micron    streaming     55  160   0.01  64
/rerank      llama-s   non-stream   980 2600   2.9   5200
```

Lena (SRE): rerank p99 still high. Noted avg_tokens — large batches are driving it. Are they using our dedicated pool?

Kai (Customer): yes we do for rerank. We hit an OOM yesterday at ~03:10 UTC causing a fallback to lighter model. That triggered a retry and a user-facing slowdown.

Maya (CS): thanks Kai. Onboarding notes: we've scheduled a deep-dive enablement session for their ML infra team on Wed. Renewal health: usage growth stable but embed spend rising; potential pricing review coming.

Ravi (Solutions): recommendations: enable streaming for /chat by default (p95 down ~45%, p99 also tighter). For rerank: limit batch tokens to 2k and enable early-exit heuristics; encourage async retry with exponential backoff.

Maya (CS): Action items:
- Ravi: draft a short runbook for rerank batching + backoff and share to Kai before Wed.
- Lena: add temporary headroom on dedicated pool (add +1 GPU, bump memory) and monitor OOM rate.
- Maya: send tailored cost forecast and renewal talking points to Kai.

OpsBot: Created ticket CH-2026-4432 assigned to Lena — "SummitAI rerank OOM + retry tuning".

Ravi (Solutions): quick curl example to flip streaming on for chat routes: 

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"/chat","model":"t6-large","stream":true}'
```

Kai (Customer): I'll test streaming in staging tonight and confirm if p99 improves. Also please include a pointer to the budget cap for embed volume.

Maya (CS): noted — I'll include cap options in the cost forecast. Next quick sync Friday 9am PT. :spiral_calendar:
